title: axo: remote access
summary: People pair their Macs with a one-time code, then open a terminal on them from a browser, through Cloudflare Access and a relay of Durable Objects. Add Macs and phones, lose messages, revoke a Mac.

title: Feynman's examples
summary: Seven well-known systems, each with a real bug: retries that debit twice, two-phase commit deciding too early, a lease lock without fencing, a stale cache fill, leader election, a job queue doing work twice, and a switch. Step through them, lose messages, and read the checker's counterexamples.
